# Owlsey

> Owlsey (owlsey.com) is a custom software studio based in Surat, Gujarat, India. It designs, builds and supports custom web applications, mobile apps, internal tools, integrations and SaaS products for growing businesses.

## Key facts

- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India; works with clients in India.
- Building software since 2020; 28+ projects delivered.
- Team: 7–8 core engineers plus a specialist network.
- Engagement: free discovery, then a written scope and a fixed estimate before any build work starts.
- Delivery: a demo every week; each finished part is tested and handed over for review as it is built.
- Ownership: the source code, designs and IP belong to the client. NDA signed on request.
- Support: the first months after launch are included at no cost, as set in the agreement.
- Contact: hello@owlsey.com — replies within three business days.

## How Owlsey works

- Hard problems are welcome: Owlsey works out how a difficult requirement can be done before deciding whether it should.
- No fixed stack: each project gets the technology that fits its users, scale and the team that will run it.
- Owlsey suggests, not just follows: when a different technology or approach will give a better result, it says so, with the reason, before building.

## What Owlsey builds

- Web applications: customer portals, booking systems and business platforms.
- Mobile products: iOS and Android apps, including offline support.
- Internal tools: dashboards and admin panels that replace spreadsheets and manual handoffs.
- Connected systems: integrations between CRM, ERP, payments and other tools.
- SaaS platforms: subscription products with accounts, billing and roles.
- AI and data: assistants, document processing and reporting.
- E-commerce and fintech: stores, checkout, payment gateways and ledgers.
- Cloud infrastructure: hosting, automated deployments and backups.

## Frequently asked questions

- How much does a custom software project cost? It depends on scope, integrations and timeline. Owlsey starts with a free discovery, then gives a written scope and a fixed estimate before build work begins — no open-ended billing.
- How will we see progress? A demo every week. Each finished part is handed over for review as it is built, so changes surface early.
- Who owns the code and the product? The client. Source code, designs and accounts are handed over, and the repository can live in the client's own organisation from day one.
- Will you sign an NDA? Yes, before any details about the product or business are shared.
- Can you take over an existing product? Yes. Owlsey starts with a code and architecture review, then stabilises, extends or rebuilds in stages without stopping the business.
- What happens after launch? Monitoring, fixes, updates and new features on a monthly support plan, with the first months included as set in the agreement — or a full handover with documentation.
